$comment: Input for agtnames/agt-site scripts/publish-manifest.mjs (owner 0x7f4a...7566). name/owner/updated/agt/signature are filled in by the script, which also drops any key it does not know. The mcp endpoint is the read-only signal-database server deployed from foresight-md (api/mcp.js).
description: A strategic foresight agent. Scans signals of change and clusters them into drivers, builds genuinely divergent scenarios, writes evidence-based forecasts and artifacts from the future, maps cascading implications, pressure-tests strategies, and backcasts roadmaps, all grounded in a persistent, cited signal database. Install it in Claude Code from github.com/ds1/foresight-plugin; published analysis at foresight.domains/insights.

capabilities.description: Bold, evidence-based forecasts with driving forces, implications cascade, shadow analysis and confidence assessment.
Signal scans: source-disciplined sweeps for emerging change, clustered into STEEP+V drivers.
Scenario building on 2x2 uncertainty matrices, backcasting, implications mapping, and historical-pattern analysis.
Assumption challenge: inversion tests, pre-mortems, red teaming and wildcard injection.
Artifacts from the future (news articles, memos, product pages) and investment memos through a futures lens.
Automated pattern detection over the signal database: clusters, convergences, accelerations, contradictions, gaps.
Every signal carries a verifiable source, ranked by an explicit source hierarchy.
